Title: 494418-2026: Italy – Design services for bridges – Engineering and architecture services for the construction of the new bridge over the Meduna River along state road 13 - Pontebbana
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Construction of a new road bridge is fundamentally relevant for sbp, as road bridges are among the preferred project types. The rating could be higher or lower depending on span/structural type and the award criteria, which are not specified here.
titel: Engineering and architectural services for the construction of the new bridge over the Meduna River along state road 13 - Pontebbana
kurzbeschreibung: The Friuli Venezia Giulia Region has awarded engineering and architectural services for the construction of a new road bridge over the Meduna River on state road 13 (Pontebbana) in Pordenone. The planning package includes comprehensive bridge design services.
wettbewerb_art: Award of planning services (open procedure, design services for bridges)
gewinner: Politecnica Ingegneria ed Architettura Società Cooperativa; Cooprogetti S.C.R.L.; Idrostudi S.r.l.; Rina Consulting S.p.A.; Matildi+Partners
gewinner_rolle: Design team for engineering and architectural services (bridge design)
gewinner_kontakt: Contract value for planning services: 2222303.39 EUR (excluding VAT); E-mail: politecnicaingarch@legalmail.it; Telephone: +39 059356527; Address: 41126 Modena, Italy
projektbeteiligte: Client: Regione autonoma Friuli Venezia Giulia - Direzione centrale infrastrutture e territorio - Servizio Opere Strategiche (E-mail: territorio@regione.fvg.it, Tel.: +39 0432555721); Design team (winner): Politecnica Ingegneria ed Architettura Società Cooperativa; Cooprogetti S.C.R.L.; Idrostudi S.r.l.; Rina Consulting S.p.A.; Matildi+Partners (role: engineering and architectural services for the construction of the bridge)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Construction of a new road bridge with a dedicated bridge design contract (CPV 71322300)
- Larger fee volume for planning services (approx. EUR 2.2 million), indicating a significant bridge project
- International project in Europe, potentially an interesting reference in the Italian market
- Structural design is an integral part of the awarded scope of services, therefore rather limited potential for direct involvement as designer
- Cooperation with an established Italian bridge design team (Politecnica/Rina/Matildi+Partners) is fundamentally interesting
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is outside Germany, formal checking engineer role according to the German system is not envisaged
- Larger road bridge could nevertheless require an independent third-party review, but this has not been tendered
- Public client in Italy, where there are usually their own review and approval procedures
- No indication of separate checking or control engineering services in the notice
baukosten_erklaerung: Estimate: fee for planning services approx. EUR 2.22 million with an estimated contract value of EUR 4.79 million; for a new road bridge of this size, construction costs of approx. EUR 30–50 million are realistic, mid-range value assumed
naechste_schritte: No immediate acquisition need for structural design, as planning services have been fully awarded. Optional: contact the winning team (Politecnica Ingegneria ed Architettura, e-mail: politecnicaingarch@legalmail.it, tel.: +39 059356527) to explore general cooperation opportunities for future bridge projects in Italy.
notes: Structural design is part of the awarded planning contract (CPV 71322300 design services for bridges), therefore no basis for approaching the winner for additional structural design. Project remains of interest as a reference observation for the Italian bridge market.
